summary: Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC, as depositor, reported under Item 1.01 that it and Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust 2026-C entered into transaction documents for an auto-loan asset-backed securitization, alongside a September 22, 2026 Rule 424(b)(2) prospectus. Agreements dated September 1, 2026 include an indenture with Bank of New York Mellon as trustee, amended trust agreement with U.S. Bank Trust, receivables purchase agreement, sale and servicing agreement with Ford Motor Credit as sponsor/servicer, administration and account control agreements, and an asset representations review agreement. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation.
